regions.name: initial_data
regions.evidence: Pointer tables, strings, constants, and jump tables end at the executable entry point.

regions.name: text
regions.evidence: Starts at the PS-X EXE entry point and ends after the final jr ra delay slot at 0x800906d0.

regions.name: initialized_data
regions.evidence: Begins with executable metadata and DATA file paths; ends at the startup clear-loop destination.

regions.name: bss_image
regions.evidence: The entry point explicitly clears this exact address range before establishing the runtime stack and global pointer.

regions.name: reserved_zero
regions.evidence: Zero-filled gap between the runtime-cleared range and the first fixed-address high-data bank.

regions.name: overlay_slot_8013a000
regions.evidence: MODEL executable slot A begins at 0x8013A000; the resident image contains slot identifiers at 0x8013A000 and 0x8013B000.

regions.name: overlay_slot_80146000
regions.evidence: WA phase loads replace this bank and resident code calls targets beginning at 0x801462B0.

regions.name: overlay_slot_80168000
regions.evidence: WA screen packages replace this bank and resident code calls targets throughout 0x80168xxx.

regions.name: overlay_slot_8017a000
regions.evidence: MODEL supplies executable content at 0x8017A000 while WA terrain records replace data from 0x8017A1D8.

regions.name: overlay_slot_80180000
regions.evidence: SU loads replace this bank and resident code calls targets throughout 0x80180xxx.

regions.name: tail_data
regions.evidence: Dense structured tables and encoded data with no resident function-return signatures.
